project.name: shared-persistence
project.description: The shared data-access coupling surface. Holds ONLY the JPA entities and repositories for tables accessed by more than one service: catalog_items (read by Catalog, Checkout, Analytics), inventory_stock (written by Checkout, read by Inventory), and scan_events (written by Checkout, read by Analytics). Single-owner tables stay private to their service. This is a plain library jar (no @SpringBootApplication, no repackage) so services depend on it without inheriting a runnable app.
